summary: Full backend (pytest) + frontend (Playwright, 390x844 mobile) end-to-end testing for BCS Pre K Conference app. All 10 backend tests pass and all 19 frontend feature checks pass. Admin edit-and-persist verified via reload. Feedback shows Thank You (no DB save). All seeded data (7 agenda / 4 sessions / 4 resources) loads with _id excluded.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay can intercept clicks on bottom-nav tabs (especially Sessions and More) on mobile width 390px because it sits near the bottom-right corner. Navigation via direct URL works fine. This is preview-env injected, not app code, but may affect end-user tap experience in this preview.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is used inside seed_defaults() but defined at module-bottom (line 287) AFTER include_router(). Works because startup runs after module import completes, but it is fragile—move logging.basicConfig + logger to the top of the file, before any function that references it.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Migrate to a lifespan context manager for future-proofing.

server.py: CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Either set credentials False or provide explicit origin list via CORS_ORIGINS.
server.py: No POST validation for `type` in AgendaItem (allows arbitrary strings beyond general|keynote|rotation|break). Consider Literal[...] or Enum.

Frontend Layout: bottom nav z-index is 50 and full app is wrapped in max-w-2xl, but the Emergent preview badge overlay can intercept clicks on the right-side tabs. Consider increasing bottom-nav z-index above 9999 or making the badge container pointer-events:none in dev only — minor, optional.
seed_data_creation: None added; existing seed data (agenda x7, sessions x4, resources x4) used as-is. Admin edit test used 'TEST_ADMIN_EDIT_VERIFY' marker and reverted to original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All API endpoints (/api/agenda, /api/sessions, /api/resources, /api/admin/verify-pin) work and exclude _id. Note: backend `/` (without /api) is NOT reachable via ingress — it returns the frontend HTML. The actual health endpoint reachable from outside is GET /api/. Frontend NavLink clicks on bottom tabs can be intercepted by the preview's 'Made with Emergent' badge; for Playwright tests, use direct page.goto(url) for navigation, or inject CSS to hide #emergent-badge. data-testids are comprehensive and reliable.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. The single quirk (overlay click interception on bottom-nav tab-sessions / tab-more) is caused by the preview-environment injected 'Made with Emergent' anchor, not application code. Mitigation in tests: navigate by URL or hide #emergent-badge via init script.
